# Frequently Asked Questions

:::cdi-message
- **ID:** JIO-R06
- **Type:** Reference
- **Audience:** Learners
- **Theme:** Common Questions
:::

## I have never used a computer before. Can I still learn?

Yes. Everyone starts somewhere.

## What if I make mistakes?

Mistakes help us learn and improve.

## Do I need internet all the time?

No. Many activities can also be practiced offline.

## How fast should I learn?

Learn at your own pace.

Growth happens step by step.
